hypotheses.C1_previous_role_beats_random_context: Previous-role categories beat matched random previous-token roles by at least 0.01 recovery at either budget on both evaluation halves.
hypotheses.C2_context_beats_static_human: At least one readable contextual scheme beats static human categories by at least 0.005 recovery at a matched budget on both halves.
hypotheses.C3_context_advantage_is_not_only_more_ty: Any winning contextual scheme also beats random context with the same category count.
hypotheses.C4_context_program_is_prediction_useful: At least one contextual scheme reaches 0.85 native top-1 agreement.
